capabilities: forward selected emails to a TaskRobin alias
save emails as markdown files in a vault folder
download email attachments alongside the notes
configure storage directory and attachment preferences
extras: Freemium service: 7-day free trial, then subscription plans start at $4.99/month; email processing runs through TaskRobin servers rather than locally.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to archive emails and their attachments as searchable notes inside the vault.
summary: Email sync service that forwards selected emails and their attachments into the vault as Markdown files via TaskRobin.
